front.title: OAuth 2.0 JWT Authorization Grant with DPoP Binding

abstract.t: This specification defines a new OAuth 2.0 authorization grant type for exchanging a JSON Web Token (JWT) assertion that is bound to a key for an access token. To use the assertion, the client must prove possession of that key using the Demonstrating Proof of Possession (DPoP) mechanism. Unlike the JWT bearer grant, a stolen assertion cannot be used by a party that does not hold the private key.
